visualCharacteristics: A compact carousel of small article cards, each a picture with a short title, sliding one card per step with prev/next chevron buttons.
contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 holds the picture, cell 2 holds an h3 whose link is the card title and target (the whole card becomes the link); optional extra paragraphs become card text.
usage: Use to list a handful of linked articles or promotions (such as Priority giveaways) as small image cards in a slider.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any row of small linked teaser cards that should slide; use media-carousel for large full-image slides.
